body:
**Summary**

This migrates the e-commerce code to TypeScript **so that the routing system is easier to implement**. TypeScript is supported by Parcel by default so there's no additional configuration needed.

The code in the widgets files don't contain explicit types so JavaScript users can still copy/paste if needed.

**Result**

No changes in the UI.
